name: AP Psychology
tagline: Content from Phineas's AP Psych study kit, used with his permission and reformatted by David. Pick a unit; progress in each one is saved in this browser.

units.label: Unit 0
units.title: Perspectives, Research & Statistics
units.blurb: The seven perspectives, research methods, and statistics and data.

units.label: Unit 1
units.title: Neuroscience, Senses, Sleep & Drugs
units.blurb: The neuron, neurotransmitters, the nervous and endocrine systems, the brain, vision, the other senses, and sleep, consciousness and drugs. Optional: split brain.

units.label: Unit 5
units.title: Health, Disorders & Treatment
units.blurb: Health psychology, an introduction to disorders, anxiety, depressive and bipolar, neurodevelopmental, dissociative, schizophrenia spectrum, OCD and trauma, eating and personality disorders, and treatment.

units.label: Perception
units.title: Perception
units.blurb: Attention, top-down vs. bottom-up processing, thresholds, and ESP, from the Perception slides.
